tags.feature: Player select screen fits on ultrawides: Drew wider player select screen art & all the options stay in view on ultrawides now at 2560x1080 and 3440x1440

Player feedback: Player select screen - LB button or space/right mouse can now cycle through time, lives and paint options quickly while holding the harpoon on them. LB or RB can cycle through paint options while roaming around but it's only mentioned in a tool tip

Player feedback: Alt+Enter or F11 will toggle windowed/fullscreen mode to make it easier to move a window to another monitor. If you have an ultrawide that you are bringing the window to, resetting players or finishing a round will correct the settings right now
Player select screen: Level sign bases light up when active

notes.title: 4K & Ultrawide Objective/Tutorial Fixes for August 14
notes.content:
[list]
[*] I fixed the objective/tutorial and pause menu sizing for 4K & ultrawide resolutions. 4K from a desktop was something I overlooked as I had been focused on Steam Deck output to TVs.
[*] Work continues on ultrawide support as I'll adjust the player select area and the level camera in some cases.
[*] Created a branch to preserve the original launch version.
[/list]

Thank you for playing!  More updates to come.

[i]-Tom[/i]

notes.title: New Carpoon Demo!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5lDMs6Y5syA;full][/previewyoutube]

Carpoon has evolved a lot since its original demo! Try out the new demo with:

• Parkin’ Panic graphics refresh & geyser jumps
• Steam Deck & 1440p support
• Player position & colours save after each round
• New camera system
• Semi-secret cameo hat
• Lots of QoL improvements
• Trucklings that follow you

Thank you for your support! 
-Tom

notes.title: Adding in Objective Art
notes.content:
I recently finished Carpoon’s second last milestone to more clearly show objectives before matches. One more to go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38366190/f41318f03815aa0404fafcbc54690298aa58c541.gif[/img]

Here's my devlog on implementing the objectives and other recent changes:
[previewyoutube=FU94h4Va-0I;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FU94h4Va-0I[/previewyoutube]

And I did add a setting to skip the objectives once you are used to them

Other Updates
• Harpoonable start button replaced floating text

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38366190/e310edf8c23ac57cded117b5f6c8dcd8e67b4b84.gif[/img]

• Signs that require holding the harpoon
• Tried analog input to drive slower at times
• Hold brake (L-Trigger) to go in reverse in tight spots

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38366190/2b3eb765673bf85e31ea8a85358af49cbb701209.gif[/img]

•Key art update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38366190/4bbcaa86fe75b9bc29698c00406b999040333e22.png[/img]

Only 1 more milestone to go to improve some of the risk vs reward game essence in VS mode! I’ve already started by changing the “parking lot” in VS to waves as well to keep a limited number of targets. 

Thanks for reading and following along!
-Tom

notes.title: The Road to Carpoon’s First Tournament, Held at LTX 2023 + Recent Progress
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=08-7ix9-c5g;full][/previewyoutube]

Carpoon recently had its first tournament as a mystery game at LTX 2023. Thank you to my friends for the countless hours they helped test Carpoon, to LTX for the opportunity, and to all the tournament players!

Fixed before the tournament, there was a semi-rare hard crash while harpooning that turned out to be partially related to inheritance, and now things are easier for me to adjust. More on the tournament in the video.

Other notable updates:
• In simultaneous grapples, an A-button will appear and it’s a frantic race to out-mash the other player to break free. This fixes stalemates that were happening in VS when ropes couldn’t be cut

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38366190/19dab029b0bf683190bffd9718653c292b05aff7.gif[/img]

• Baby trucks on your team drive to you when you honk your horn with a right stick click. In this last truck standing mode, there are also now trophies for second and third place

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38366190/79f9a2b8ed0ee5362d145efa8bbdbcd7095e753f.gif[/img]

• Player trucks now recoil back off harpoon shots and rumble

Next up: Going over more feedback and smoothing out the camera

-Tom
